summary: Shows ansible-vault create with a vault ID from a password file or a prompt; it opens $EDITOR (default vi) and saves the file encrypted with a header reflecting the vault ID.
questions: How do I create a new encrypted file with Ansible Vault?
Which editor does ansible-vault create use?
How do I create an encrypted file and set its password at a prompt?

answer_card.title: Create an encrypted file
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-vault create --vault-id test@multi_password_file foo.yml
```

This opens `$EDITOR` (default `vi`). When you close it, the file is saved encrypted, with a header like `$ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.2;AES256;test`.

To be prompted for a new password:

```bash
ansible-vault create --vault-id my_new_password@prompt foo.yml
```

Store that password somewhere so you can decrypt the file later.
